notes: Thin wrapper over max_flow_value with unit caps + i64 cast. The textbook 6v/8e instance runs faster than the FL-010 mincut textbook (1.10 µs vs 1.57 µs) because the unit-capacity Network::build path is slightly cheaper than the weighted one (vs. capacity=None vs. Some(&[..])). Wrapper overhead (round + bounds check) is sub-nanosecond and lost in noise. Layered scaling matches FL-002 / FL-010 closely as expected (same Dinic backend). Throughput rises with E because per-vertex BFS amortizes more arcs.
